contracts: (The obligation-specific A25 artifact assertions pass and the current whole-plan terminal selection passes after all four modules are authored and required behaviors exercised. Q2 freezes tests/helpers before formal execution; implementation cannot alter frozen snapshots. Required regression coverage remains nonempty, shared production changes invalidate affected proofs, and replay rebuilds the original binding identity before using that same identity. Missing real-entry materialization blocks the owning workflow rather than authorizing Q2 production writes. No internal reviewer receipt, approval absence, historical status or assistant statement substitutes for current checks. Targeted commands have 300-second caller timeouts; terminal has 600 seconds. Historical failures remain intact, and derived evidence authorizes=[].) AND (The obligation-specific test_a25 artifact assertion passes against current production artifacts, and one current whole-plan validation passes all four required modules after their tests are authored and product behaviors exercised. Use a 300-second targeted timeout and 600-second terminal timeout; timeout is harness failure, never accepted RED. Freeze tests/helpers before formal execution; implementation cannot edit them. Maintain nonempty applicable regression coverage, invalidate affected proofs after shared semantic changes, and preserve historical evidence. Do not manufacture RED from missing production imports or absent tests; report the first-use callable limitation through its existing owner. ADR-0041 governs development; the standard ADR requires normal maintainer acceptance before final Package A acceptance, without treating missing approval as product RED or self-accepting a draft. This guard neither enables internal review nor authorizes changes to existing workflow controllers.)
selector_intents: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_migration.py::test_a25 must bind ASSERT_A25_COMPLETION_GATE_HAS_NO_REVIEWER_ENABLEMENT to explicit inspection of completion criteria and referenced handoff instructions. A criterion enabling an internal reviewer must produce an observable AssertionError. This is an artifact boundary guard, not an expected-red runtime role; missing files, import errors, timeouts or unavailable inspection cannot substitute for that assertion.

scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_migration.py::test_a25 must produce an assertion failure if the actual standard or applicable policy/schema makes internal review mandatory, or if scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package rejects an otherwise compliant disposable package because internal-review evidence is absent. Assert this obligation independently within A25. Use the targeted argv command with a caller-enforced 300-second timeout. This is an artifact/prerequisite guard, not expected-red; missing imports, missing authored tests, unavailable production entry and timeouts are harness or first-use blockers, never this causal failure.
